about_the_game:
Exilium: Kiro - A Steampunk Fantasy Visual Novel

Overview:
Dive into the gritty, magic-lit streets of Dalmar, the capital of a vast empire where blood magic clashes with steam-powered marvels. You are Onuk—a mere human, a street thug fighting for survival in a city that chews up and spits out the weak. Your only currency is your life, and you're willing to bet it all to find your place in this terrifying machine. In Dalmar, everyone must know their place. The question is, how will you carve out yours?

The World of Exilium:
For over a decade in the making, the world of Exilium is a rich, living universe born from our original tabletop RPG. This is not a generic fantasy:

  • A Clash of Eras: Experience a unique blend of dark fantasy and industrial revolution, where sorcery is a weapon and technology is a cruel miracle.

  • A Tapestry of Races: Interact with a diverse cast of Dvergs, Sylphs, Humans, Zels, Ogres, Mogres, and magically-engineered hybrids.

  • Vampires Reimagined: Forget outcasts. Here, vampires are war heroes, a biological weapon revered and feared by the Empire.

Your Story:
Forge your path through the horrors of the Lower City's underbelly. Make dangerous alliances, face impossible choices, and risk everything you have—because you have nothing left to lose. This kinetic visual novel pulls you deep into a story of survival, power, and finding your worth in a world that tells you you have none.

Key Features:

  • A Deep, Original World: Explore the decade-developed lore of Exilium, a setting where every alley has a history.

  • A Hardboiled Protagonist: Live as Onuk, a human bandit using wits and grit to survive in a city designed to break him.

  • Mature & Gripping Narrative: A story for adults, dealing with themes of survival, social hierarchy, and the cost of ambition.

  • Stunning Visuals: Immerse yourself in the grim and beautiful city of Dalmar through detailed artwork and character portraits.

  • Kinetic Experience: A focused, linear narrative ensures you experience every twist and turn of Onuk's fateful journey.

    Due to a new Steam policy, all new NSFW content will be released as free DLC in future updates.

content_descriptors.notes:
This game is intended for a mature audience and contains content that may not be suitable for all players. It includes depictions of violence, sexual content, strong language, and use of fictional substances.

Sexual Content:

The game contains depictions of consensual sexual acts between adult characters. These scenes include partial or full nudity but are not explicit or pornographic in nature. They are presented within the context of the story and character relationships.

Violence:

The game features stylized violence of a fantasy nature. This includes combat with melee weapons and magic, resulting in blood effects and injuries on characters and environments. Some story moments may depict more intense or graphic violence in line with the dark themes of the narrative.

Strong Language:

The dialogue throughout the game contains frequent use of strong and offensive language, including profanity and crude humor.

Fictional Substance Use:

Characters are shown consuming fictional magical substances (e.g., potions, elixirs) that have mind-altering or enhancing effects. These depictions are analogous to the use of drugs or alcohol in our world and are part of the game's world-building and storytelling.

Sensitive Themes:

The game's storyline explores mature and complex themes such as moral ambiguity, psychological stress, and power struggles. However, it does not contain depictions of sexual assault, non-consensual sex, or self-harm.

Please consider this information before making your purchase.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 18.04 LTS (64-bit) or equivalent distribution
  • Processor: Intel Core 2 Duo or AMD equivalent (2.0+ GHz, 64-bit)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 3.3 compatible graphics card with updated drivers
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
  • Additional Notes: Requires glibc 2.27 or newer and a 64-bit operating system.
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Ubuntu 22.04 LTS (64-bit) or a recent equivalent distribution
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or AMD equivalent (64-bit)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 4.6 compatible graphics card with updated drivers
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
